arguments.command:
python - <<'PY'
import os,re
for r,d,f in os.walk('src'):
  for file in f:
    if file.endswith('.py'):
      path=os.path.join(r,file)
      with open(path,'r') as t: lines=t.readlines()
      new=[]
      for line in lines:
        m=re.match(r'(\s*)(\w+):\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*".*"', line)
        if m:
          indent, name, typ = m.groups()
          if typ=='int': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: int = 0\n"
          elif typ=='list[int]': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: list[int] = [1]\n"
          elif typ=='bool': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: bool = True\n"
          elif typ=='str': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: str = \"\"\n"
          elif typ=='float': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: float = 0.0\n"
          elif typ=='dict[str, int]': new_line=f"{indent}{name}: dict[str, int] = {{'x':1}}\n"
          else: new_line=line
          new.append(new_line)
        else:
          new.append(line)
      with open(path,'w') as t: t.writelines(new)
print('fixed')
PY
